title: ONE LIME TAB ON THE RAID HUD, A SHORTER DEMO GUN CARD
why: The critic on the raid screen (10-19): the lime tick on every panel spends the accent, and the ammo card has an empty strip now the demo hides the item line and backpack hint. Style guide: the tab marks the star panel only.
now: Only the gun card keeps its lime tab, and in the demo it is shorter.

edits.replacement:
// v28.xx (cw-hudstar), the critic (2026-10-19) on the raid HUD: 'the lime tick on every panel spends the accent'. The style guide gives the 2px tab to the panel that is the star (the gun card, the ammo). Every other raid panel passes plain=1 and draws no tab.
function hudPanel(x,y,w,h,a,plain){

edits.anchor: if(w>c+20){ ctx.fillStyle='#e6ff3d'; ctx.fillRect(x+c+4,y,Math.min(36,w*0.25),2); }   // the amber tick of the menu plate (ui6)
edits.replacement: if(w>c+20&&!plain){ ctx.fillStyle='#e6ff3d'; ctx.fillRect(x+c+4,y,Math.min(36,w*0.25),2); }   // the tab of the menu plate (ui6); v28.xx (cw-hudstar): only where plain is not set

edits.anchor: hudPanel(bx,by,bw,bh);   // v18.13: the one HUD panel
edits.replacement: hudPanel(bx,by,bw,bh,undefined,1);   // v18.13: the one HUD panel

edits.anchor: hudPanel(PADX-8,y0-LH(13),LW,boxH);   // v18.13: the one HUD panel
hudPanel(mx-8,my-6,MW,MH+10);   // v18.13: the one HUD panel
edits.replacement: hudPanel(mx-8,my-6,MW,MH+10,undefined,1);   // v18.13: the one HUD panel

/* v28.xx (cw-hudstar): the demo hides the item line and the backpack hint (Q56), so the card is 72 high and not 100 with an empty strip; it keeps the tab, it is the star */
       if(_wpw>LH(60)){ var _gtop=trDemo()?LH(76):LH(90), _gh=trDemo()?LH(72):LH(100); hudPanel(_wpx,by-_gtop,_wpw,_gh,0.62); }
